description: This file defines the AppManager class within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It declares the class as a plugin implementing IPlugin and JSONRPC interfaces, along with a nested Notification class for handling remote connection and app manager notifications. The file includes method declarations for initialization, deinitialization, and information retrieval, as well as internal members for managing connections, services, and notifications.

classes.name: AppManager
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing application management and notification handling within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: Nested class within AppManager for handling remote connection and app manager notifications, implementing interfaces for connection and app lifecycle event notifications.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the AppManager plugin with the provided service shell.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the AppManager plugin, cleaning up resources.
